header.running_head: How the Ansaar Severed the Ties they had During the Period of Ignorance to Strengthen the Ties of Islaam

When I got back to Rasulullaah ﷺ and informed him about the events, he asked me to stretch out my leg. When I did so, he passed his and over my leg and it (was cured so well that it) felt as if nothing was ever wrong with it." [^1]

Another narration states that when Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Ateek (RA) and the others came back to Rasulullaah ﷺ, he was on the pulpit and (seeing them approach he) said, "The faces of success!" They replied, "It is your face that is successful, O Rasulullaah ﷺ!" He then asked, "Have you killed him?" When they replied in the affirmative, Rasulullaah ﷺ asked to see the sword. Rasulullaah ﷺ then drew the sword from its sheath and (after inspecting it he) said, "Yes! Here are traces of food on the blade." [^2]
The Jew Ibn Shayba is Killed

The daughter of Hadhrat Muhayyisa (RA) narrates from her father that when Rasulullaah ﷺ once permitted the Sahabah (RA) to kill any Jew they could, Hadhrat Muhayyisa (RA) attacked and killed a Jewish trader called Ibn Shayba who interacted and traded with the Muslims. When Hadhrat Muhayyisa (RA) did this, his elder brother Hadhrat Huwayyisa (RA) who was not yet a Muslim started hitting Hadhrat Muhayyisa (RA) saying, "You enemy of Allaah! You have killed him whereas I can swear by Allaah that most of the fat in your stomach has come from his wealth." Hadhrat Muhayyisa (RA) replied, "I swear by Allaah that had Rasulullaah ﷺ commanded me to kill you, I would have decapitated you." This was the beginning of Hadhrat Huwayyisa's conversion to Islaam. (Surprised by this statement of his brother's), Hadhrat Huwayyisa (RA) asked, "Had Muhammad ﷺ commanded you to kill me, you would have done it?" Hadhrat Muhayyisa (RA) replied, "By Allaah! I certainly would." Hadhrat Huwayyisa (RA) then commented, "By Allaah! The religion that has taken you to this must certainly be astounding." [^3]

Another narration quotes that Hadhrat Muhayyisa (RA) said, "That personality has commanded me to kill Ibn Shayba for whom I shall even kill you if he so commands me." This narration also adds that Hadhrat Huwayyisa (RA) then accepted Islaam. [^4]
